name: langchain-salesforce
headline: AI-research-SKILLs: Open-Source AI Skills Library
short_description: The AI-research-SKILLs library offers a comprehensive collection of open-source AI research and engineering skills, helping AI models with enhanced capabilities. Developed by Orchestra Research, it serves as a powerful resource for building advanced AI agents.
author: zechenzhangAGI

sections.overview:
AI-research-SKILLs is an organized collection of 90+ open-source skills designed to enhance AI agent capabilities across research and engineering domains. The library includes specialized skills organized into 23 categories, ranging from agent-native research artifacts to model architecture analysis and data processing. Each skill is documented with YAML frontmatter, detailed markdown documentation, and working code examples that AI agents can directly use. Developers building Claude agents, Cursor tools, or other AI systems can integrate these skills to add domain-specific research, analysis, and engineering capabilities. The library is actively maintained by Orchestra Research and distributed via GitHub and npm, with regular updates introducing new skill categories and improvements.
Enhance the capabilities of existing AI models by integrating advanced research skills.
Develop custom AI research agents that can autonomously conduct experiments.
Integrate AI skills into applications to provide enhanced functionalities and user experiences.
Facilitate collaboration among AI researchers by sharing and utilizing a common set of skills.
sections.usage:
```
Using the AI-research-SKILLs library, analyze the [DATASET] to identify patterns in [SPECIFIC_METRIC]. Compare these findings with historical data from [TIME_PERIOD]. Generate a report that includes key insights, visualizations, and actionable recommendations for [TEAM_OR_INDIVIDUAL].
```
Copy

```
After analyzing the sales performance dataset from Q1 2023, the AI-research-SKILLs library identified a significant drop in conversion rates for the North American region. The analysis revealed that the conversion rate decreased by 15% compared to Q1 2022, with the most notable decline occurring in the tech sector. The AI-generated report included a detailed breakdown of the affected regions and sectors, along with visualizations highlighting the trends. Recommendations included targeted marketing campaigns for the tech sector and a review of the sales strategy for the North American region. The report also suggested leveraging Mode's interactive dashboards to monitor progress and adjust strategies in real-time.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot
Advanced skill - requires experience with AI agents
